description: This file defines the UploadStream class, which manages a custom PHP stream wrapper for handling upload files within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for stream registration, file and directory operations, and Suhosin security checks.

classes.name: UploadStream
classes.description: A PHP stream wrapper class for handling upload streams, including verification of Suhosin security restrictions, directory management, and stream operations such as open, read, write, and delete.

methods.name: getSuhosinStatus
methods.description: Checks if the Suhosin PHP extension allows the use of the upload stream based on its configuration and whitelist/blacklist settings.

methods.name: getDir
methods.description: Returns the directory used for uploads, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: writable
methods.description: Checks if the upload directory is writable.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the custom upload stream wrapper with PHP.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Resolves a given 'upload://' stream path to an actual filesystem path, ensuring security constraints.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Ensures the directory for a given upload path exists, creating it if necessary.
